name: Mechanical Wonder (Mobility)

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond item page in signed-in Chrome on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/10771765-mechanical-wonder. Prices use the existing rarity convention; unspecified weight is 0.

summary: Wound up and strapped to your back, it gives you a Speed of 30 feet for 24 hours.
text: Wind this wonder with its key for 1 minute and strap it to your back or flank: for the next 24 hours it gives you a Speed of 30 feet, and no one else can take it off you without your consent. (The game treats it as wound whenever it's worn.)
